1.consolidated_definition: pol. Efecto congelante. Práctica que tiene el efecto de impedir el ejercicio del derecho. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Exigir tan difícil condición tendría un efecto congelante (chilling effect) sobre la función legislativa, que devastaría la democracia representativa, sobre todo con respecto de aquellos representantes del pueblo que no son expertos en asuntos constitucionales (Tribunal Supremo de PR, 23-01-01)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Chilling effect: A congealing effect. Practice that has the effect of preventing the exercise of a right. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. To demand such a difficult condition would have a chilling effect on legislative function, which would devastate representative democracy, especially with regard to those representatives of the people who are not experts in constitutional matters (Supreme Court of PR, 23-01-01)
